name: RequestRelease
description: Prepare a release-approval request (maker step). Bot shows a confirm card; approval is created only after the user confirms. Does not release the order — a Manager must ApproveOrder afterwards. ALWAYS use for 'request release', 'submit for approval', 'yêu cầu duyệt', 'xin duyệt'. Never map those phrases to ReleaseOrder.

comment.description: Optional note for the approving manager.
